# ShareMii.net

> Community Mii QR code gallery and free online Mii Maker for 3DS, Wii U, and Tomodachi Life. Not the Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream save editor.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://sharemii.net/
- Browse Mii QR codes: https://sharemii.net/browse
- Free online Mii Maker: https://sharemii.net/create
- How to use ShareMii: https://sharemii.net/help
- About (brand disambiguation): https://sharemii.net/about
- Mii tags index: https://sharemii.net/tags
- Public collections: https://sharemii.net/collections/browse

## What this site is not

ShareMii.net is not https://sharemii.qwkuns.me/ — that is a separate tool for editing Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream save files (.ltd).
